2026_04_KC_LV.headline: Mahomes and Crosby headline an unbeaten AFC West collision in Las Vegas
2026_04_KC_LV.paragraph1: Kansas City and Las Vegas arrive unbeaten, turning the rivalry into an early divisional test. Patrick Mahomes has emphasized the challenge of Maxx Crosby and a Raiders defense creating turnovers, while Kansas City must account for Josh Simmons being out along the offensive line. Las Vegas counters with Kirk Cousins distributing to a healthy Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty, but Chris Jones and Steve Spagnuolo can attack the Raiders' protection after Jackson Powers-Johnson was ruled out. Protection discipline and turnover control are the central pressure points.
2026_04_KC_LV.model_rationale: Both teams can disrupt protection without sacrificing coverage integrity, making clean quarterback operation and ball security especially important in a matchup with multiple game-changing defenders.
